notes: A legacy 'R <if> <room> <vnum> -1' is an object removal after renum_zone_table; reset_zone extracts the first matching object in the room, and the dependent O then honours max-in-world. The port read legacy R as a mobile removal, so the Haven Lighthouse chests (all 30 R commands, zone 158) were never removed and a looted chest never refilled (DP-1333).

A reset command naming a missing room, mobile or object is disabled once at boot ('Invalid vnum, cmd disabled'); a disabled M then fails, and the if-flag chain skips its dependent G/E/P. No booted zone in the shipped world has one; the four zones with missing mobs (58, 85, 95, 97) are not in C's boot index.
